title: Power Down V52 post-event assurance
instructions: After event 5833 (2026-09-01 18:00-19:00 Europe/London) has ended, inspect the 30-second Power Down evidence recorder output and canonical V52 runtime state.
Run the canonical post-event verifier already committed in lifeos-platform.

Prove from recorded evidence that the event became active, live-event safety gates remained satisfied, the pre-event Enphase reserve was captured, LifeOS took reserve ownership only during the event, reserve was released to the native minimum when permitted, and the original pre-event reserve was restored after the event with ownership cleared.
Do not infer success from source code or pre-event readiness. Require actual recorded runtime evidence.
If all required evidence passes, update GitHub issue #25 with LIFEOS_WORK_STATE=PASS and RESULT=PASS_POWERDOWN_COMPLIANCE_ASSURED, including concise redacted evidence and canonical commit/job IDs.

If any evidence is missing or a safety gate blocked control, update issue #25 with LIFEOS_WORK_STATE=BLOCKED or IN_PROGRESS as appropriate, exact evidence, root cause, remaining work, and NEXT_AUTONOMOUS_ACTION. Continue safe autonomous diagnosis/remediation where possible.
Do not weaken safety thresholds, fabricate evidence, or perform unrelated battery writes.
acceptance: Actual event evidence proves reserve capture/release/restoration and live closed-loop safety, ending with RESULT=PASS_POWERDOWN_COMPLIANCE_ASSURED.
